meaning: This is a release-prerequisite register, not a successful evidence bundle or route record.

gates.scope: Run on every exact native desktop architecture; hosted CLI success does not prove native GUI behavior.

Inspect the actual installed native window on all four cells. Native custom-protocol readiness alone does not prove ten-verb lifecycle parity or the absence of listeners; retain the separate per-cell launch/interaction evidence.

gates.reason: No live tenant or Shared Drive credentials and no real immutable qualified-route bundles are available. Missing consent, licensing, enabled options, representative in-scope assets, or disposable fixture permissions must refuse without publishing qualification.
gates.scope: Exact source/destination/backend/options/guarantee-set tuple, pinned transfer version, and each desktop cell. No credential or captured-output import can assert successful qualification.

gates.reason: SharePoint rejects the source names that would exercise the driver's path-representability guard. The file suite requires an actual live source entry reaching that guard before publishing full qualification. A Graph invalid-name rejection or a separately labelled private-provenance-capacity refusal does not substitute for this proof.

nativePrerequisites.darwin: macOS 13.5 or newer with system WebKit and Node 24, on x64 or arm64. The user explicitly raised the floor to match the retained Node baseline.
nativePrerequisites.linux: A real X11 or Wayland desktop, WebKitGTK 4.1 and libxdo. Missing these blocks web only; there is no listener or external-browser fallback. Official Node GNU/Linux binaries require kernel 4.18+ and glibc 2.28+.
